{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA rows (revenue = 999999.99)
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Now check the population: new + paid_search
new_paid_search = df_clean[(df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search')]

# Check if there are any rows in this group
print(f"Number of new + paid_search customers after removing QA rows: {len(new_paid_search)}")

# Compute the fraction converted
converted_count = new_paid_search['converted'].sum()
total_count = len(new_paid_search)
fraction_converted = converted_count / total_count

print(f"Converted: {converted_count}")
print(f"Total: {total_count}")
print(f"Fraction converted: {fraction_converted}")"}
